children: Canada organic energy drink maker's Q3 net revenue rose 10% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 was positive, marking third consecutive trailing-twelve-month period
Company posted net income of C$0.5 mln for the quarter
Company enters balance of fiscal 2026 with strong demand and expanding U.S. distribution
Company prioritizes maturing new client listings and selective brand investment in high-return channels
Company expects results from GURU Hydration Week to be reflected in fourth quarter
U.S. DISTRIBUTION EXPANSION - U.S. net revenue rose nearly 60%, driven by expanded natural-channel distribution, including a new nationwide listing at a leading U.S. natural retailer

CANADIAN DIRECT DISTRIBUTION - Canadian net revenue grew 19% on a comparable basis, reflecting strengthened direct retailer relationships and expanded distribution across grocery, convenience, and wholesale club channels
HIGHER PROMOTIONAL SPEND - Gross margin declined due to elevated promotional activity and client mix as new client listings carried higher upfront trade investment
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the non-alcoholic beverages peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Guru Organic Energy Corp is C$6.50, about 75.7% above its September 8 closing price of C$3.70
The stock recently traded at 404 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 100 three months ago
